# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package

mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages

yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

Merged.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Annotated.rds', sep = '/'))

# 3. Add unique identifier to each sample CS matrix

```{r}
sample_list <- list()
all_samples <- list.files(Input_data, full.names = TRUE)

for (n in 1:length(all_samples)) {
  sample_list[[basename(all_samples[[n]])]] <- file.path(all_samples[[n]])
}
```

```{r}
ADT_count_matrices <- list()
sample_names <- c()

for (sample in names(sample_list)) {
  dir <- sample_list[[sample]]
  sample_names[[sample]] <- sample
  ADT_count_matrices[[sample]] <- Seurat::Read10X(data.dir = dir)[['Antibody Capture']]
  rm(dir)
}
```

Prior aggregation, cells across the various samples are named the same

```{r}
head(colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[1]]))
```

To avoid this, we remove the final characters '-1' and add a unique sample identifier

```{r}
for (count.mat in names(ADT_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(ADT_count_matrices))
  updated_barcodes_names <- paste(paste(substring(colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]),0,16),sep=""),'__', sample_names[index], sep = "")
  colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]) <- updated_barcodes_names
  
}
```

We can now confirm that the above step went well

```{r}
head(colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[1]]))
```

```{r}
ADT.assays <- list()
ADT_count_matrices.filtered <- list()

for (s in sample_names) {
  
  # Get the column names to keep
  CB_to_keep <- colnames(Merged.SeuratObj)[colnames(Merged.SeuratObj) %in% colnames(ADT_count_matrices[str_detect(names(ADT_count_matrices), s)][[1]])]
  
  # Filter the count matrix for the current sample
  ADT_count_matrices.filtered[[s]] <- ADT_count_matrices[str_detect(names(ADT_count_matrices), s)][[1]][, CB_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
  
}

add_zero_row_if_missing <- function(mat, feature = "HTO_CO253") {
  rn <- rownames(mat)
  if (is.null(rn)) stop("Matrix has NULL rownames; cannot target features by name.")

  idx <- match(feature, rn)

  if (!is.na(idx)) {
    mat[idx, ] <- 0
  } else {
    zero_row <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(mat), sparse = TRUE)
    rownames(zero_row) <- feature
    colnames(zero_row) <- colnames(mat)
    mat <- rbind(mat, zero_row)
  }

  mat
}

targets <- c(
  "VA022_T8_Ambiguous",
  "VA013_T8_Ambiguous", "VA013_T8_ASB", "VA013_T8_GB",
  "VA035_T8_Ambiguous", "VA035_T8_ASB", "VA035_T8_GB"
)

for (nm in targets) {
  if (!nm %in% names(ADT_count_matrices.filtered)) {
    warning("Skipping: '", nm, "' not found in ADT_count_matrices.filtered")
    next
  }

  ADT_count_matrices.filtered[[nm]] <- add_zero_row_if_missing(
    ADT_count_matrices.filtered[[nm]],
    feature = "HTO_CO253"
  )
}


Merged_ADT_count_matrix <- do.call(cbind, ADT_count_matrices.filtered)

Merged_ADT_count_matrix <- Merged_ADT_count_matrix[,colnames(Merged.SeuratObj)]

# View the merged matrix
print(Merged_ADT_count_matrix)

# Create HTO assay
HTO.assay <- CreateAssayObject(
  counts = Merged_ADT_count_matrix[str_detect(rownames(Merged_ADT_count_matrix), pattern = 'HTO'), ],
  key = 'HTO'
)

# Create ADT assay (rows that do NOT match 'HTO')
ADT.assay <- CreateAssayObject(
  counts = Merged_ADT_count_matrix[!str_detect(rownames(Merged_ADT_count_matrix), pattern = 'HTO'), ],
  key = 'ADT'
)

Merged.SeuratObj@assays[['HTO']] <- HTO.assay
Merged.SeuratObj@assays[['ADT']] <- ADT.assay

Merged.SeuratObj <- NormalizeData(Merged.SeuratObj, assay = 'ADT', margin = 2)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(Matrix)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

# ---------- REQUIRED OBJECTS ----------
# Merged.SeuratObj
# gradient_exp
# results_folder

# ---------- PALETTE ----------
cols <- c(
  "Naive B-cells"                 = "#E15759",
  "Transitional B-cells"          = "#EDC948",
  "Atypical memory B-cells"       = "#F28E2B",
  "IgM memory B-cells"            = "#76B7B2",
  "Class switched memory B-cells" = "#4E79A7",
  "CD4+ T-cells"                  = "#9C755F",
  "CD8+ T-cells"                  = "#BAB0AC",
  "NK cells"                      = "#59A14F",
  "CD14+ monocytes"               = "#FF9DA7",
  "CD16+ monocytes"               = "#B07AA1",
  "Dendritic cells"               = "#B6992D"
)

# Which ADT slot to plot:
# "data"   -> Merged.SeuratObj@assays$ADT@data  (your stated location)
# "counts" -> raw counts
ADT_SLOT <- "data"

# ---------- helpers ----------
blank_square <- function(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) {
  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    ggtitle(title, subtitle = subtitle)
}

make_dimplot_highlight_celltypes <- function(obj, ident_string, reduction = "h_umap") {
  idents_avail <- as.character(unique(obj$Identity))

  if (!ident_string %in% idents_avail) {
    return(blank_square(title = ident_string, subtitle = "Missing Identity"))
  }

  cells <- WhichCells(obj, expression = Identity %in% ident_string)
  if (length(cells) == 0) {
    return(blank_square(title = ident_string, subtitle = "No cells"))
  }

  cell_types <- obj@meta.data[cells, "Celltype"]
  cells_highlight <- split(cells, cell_types)

  # DimPlot adds its own colour scale; we replace it with your manual palette.
  # The replacement message is harmless; wrap in suppressMessages() if you want silence.
  DimPlot(
    obj,
    reduction = reduction,
    cells.highlight = cells_highlight,
    group.by = "Celltype",
    label = FALSE,
    pt.size = 1,
    sizes.highlight = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.8,
    order = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE
  ) +
    theme_void() +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, na.value = "#DCDADB", breaks = names(cols)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ggtitle(label = ident_string, subtitle = paste0("N = ", length(cells)))
}

# ADT feature plot for one identity and one target
# - Title is TARGET (not sample)
# - Legend bottom
# - No fixed limits (no global rescaling)
# - Pulls values directly from ADT slot to avoid Seurat "default locations" warnings
make_adt_plot_one_identity_one_target <- function(obj, ident_string, target,
                                                 reduction = "h_umap", adt_slot = "data") {
  idents_avail <- as.character(unique(obj$Identity))

  if (!ident_string %in% idents_avail) {
    return(blank_square(title = target, subtitle = paste0(ident_string, " missing")))
  }

  if (!"ADT" %in% names(obj@assays)) {
    return(blank_square(title = target, subtitle = "ADT assay missing"))
  }

  # Directly access ADT matrix (this is what you said you have)
  adt_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "ADT", slot = adt_slot)

  if (!target %in% rownames(adt_mat)) {
    return(blank_square(title = target, subtitle = paste0("Not in ADT@", adt_slot)))
  }

  cells <- WhichCells(obj, expression = Identity %in% ident_string)
  if (length(cells) == 0) {
    return(blank_square(title = target, subtitle = paste0(ident_string, ": no cells")))
  }

  umap_embeddings <- as.data.frame(obj@reductions[[reduction]]@cell.embeddings)
  colnames(umap_embeddings)[1:2] <- c("humap_1", "humap_2")
  umap_embeddings$cell <- rownames(umap_embeddings)

  # vector of feature values for ALL cells, indexed by cell names
  feat_vec <- as.numeric(adt_mat[target, ])
  names(feat_vec) <- colnames(adt_mat)

  umap_embeddings$feature <- feat_vec[umap_embeddings$cell]

  all_cells <- umap_embeddings
  selected_cells <- umap_embeddings[umap_embeddings$cell %in% cells, , drop = FALSE]

  n_pos <- sum(selected_cells$feature > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_tot <- nrow(selected_cells)
  pct   <- if (n_tot > 0) round((n_pos / n_tot) * 100, 1) else NA_real_

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = all_cells,
      aes(x = humap_1, y = humap_2),
      color = "#DCDADB",
      alpha = 0.3,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = selected_cells,
      aes(x = humap_1, y = humap_2, color = feature),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = gradient_exp,
      name = "CLR normalised exp.",
      na.value = "#DCDADB"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        barwidth = unit(7.5, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(0.35, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ggtitle(
      label = target,
      subtitle = paste0("ADT > 0: ", n_pos, "/", n_tot, " (", pct, "%)")
    ) +
    xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)
}

# Grid logic:
# - Col 2 (row1/row2) = targetA for T5/T8
# - Col 3 (row1/row2) = targetB for T5/T8
make_grid_for_targets2 <- function(obj, base_id, group, targets2,
                                  reduction = "h_umap", adt_slot = "data") {
  id_T5 <- paste0(base_id, "_T5_", group)
  id_T8 <- paste0(base_id, "_T8_", group)

  targetA <- targets2[1]
  targetB <- targets2[2]

  p11 <- make_dimplot_highlight_celltypes(obj, id_T5, reduction = reduction)
  p21 <- make_dimplot_highlight_celltypes(obj, id_T8, reduction = reduction)

  p12 <- if (!is.na(targetA) && nzchar(targetA)) make_adt_plot_one_identity_one_target(obj, id_T5, targetA, reduction, adt_slot) else blank_square()
  p22 <- if (!is.na(targetA) && nzchar(targetA)) make_adt_plot_one_identity_one_target(obj, id_T8, targetA, reduction, adt_slot) else blank_square()

  p13 <- if (!is.na(targetB) && nzchar(targetB)) make_adt_plot_one_identity_one_target(obj, id_T5, targetB, reduction, adt_slot) else blank_square()
  p23 <- if (!is.na(targetB) && nzchar(targetB)) make_adt_plot_one_identity_one_target(obj, id_T8, targetB, reduction, adt_slot) else blank_square()

  ((p11 + p12 + p13) /
     (p21 + p22 + p23)) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0(base_id, " - ", group))
}

# ---------- iteration setup ----------
all_idents <- as.character(unique(Merged.SeuratObj$Identity))
base_ids <- sort(unique(str_replace(all_idents, "_T(5|8)_.+$", "")))

adt_targets <- rownames(GetAssayData(Merged.SeuratObj, assay = "ADT", slot = ADT_SLOT))

# chunk into groups of 2 targets (two target columns); pad last with NA for blank right column
target_chunks2 <- split(adt_targets, ceiling(seq_along(adt_targets) / 2))
target_chunks2 <- lapply(target_chunks2, function(x) c(x, rep(NA_character_, 2 - length(x))))

dir.create(file.path(results_folder, "ADT"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------- generate & save grids ----------
for (base_id in base_ids) {
  for (group in c("GB", "ASB", "Ambiguous")) {
    for (k in seq_along(target_chunks2)) {

      targets2 <- target_chunks2[[k]]

      grid_plot <- make_grid_for_targets2(
        obj = Merged.SeuratObj,
        base_id = base_id,
        group = group,
        targets2 = targets2,
        reduction = "h_umap",
        adt_slot = ADT_SLOT
      )

      page_label <- paste(na.omit(targets2), collapse = "_")
      if (page_label == "") page_label <- paste0("page_", k)

      out_png <- file.path(
        results_folder, "ADT",
        paste0(base_id, "_", group, "_", sprintf("%02d", k), "_", page_label, ".png")
      )

      # Portable save (and uses Cairo if your system supports it)
      grDevices::png(out_png, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300,
                     type = if (capabilities("cairo")) "cairo" else "Xlib")
      print(grid_plot)
      dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```
